title: [3D Model] Event strip blank face / backing insert
body:
## Purpose
Create **event strip blank face / backing insert** for the current V5 horizontal timeline inside a surrounding galactic library. Required model in the proposed V5 scene kit.

## References
- [V5 direction and element inventory](https://github.com/dfcut8/TimeLinePrototype.Godot/blob/98751287e0f50d8fb4ad879f1571c28e2e2dc340/docs/concepts/spatial-library-v5/README.md)
- [Concept board](https://github.com/dfcut8/TimeLinePrototype.Godot/blob/98751287e0f50d8fb4ad879f1571c28e2e2dc340/docs/concepts/spatial-library-v5/04-event-panel-family.png)
- [Delivery conventions](https://github.com/dfcut8/TimeLinePrototype.Godot/blob/98751287e0f50d8fb4ad879f1571c28e2e2dc340/docs/timeline-asset-brief.md) — historical brief; V5 overrides vertical orientation, large physical frames and ornate era rings.

## Model scope and specific fit checks
Dark blank front insert with clean UVs and separate presentation material slot. Fit casing without z-fighting. Keep dates, titles and symbols live/replaceable; no baked content. Rear casing closure belongs to casing. No large physical reader display.

## Dependencies
- [Shared event strip casing](https://github.com/dfcut8/TimeLinePrototype.Godot/issues/13)

## Dimensional decisions
Resolve a consistent dimensional drawing, axes, pivot and attachment points in graybox before detailed modeling. Use 1 unit = 1 meter as the authoring convention. Concept projections are not authoritative drawings. The 14 m timeline, 40 m clear volume and 64 m chamber are exploratory proportions, not fixed dimensions. Validate camera clearance and readable strip scale together before final art; do not inherit obsolete vertical dimensions.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Complete the model scope and specific fit checks above; record the resolved dimensions and module interfaces.
- [ ] Inspect front, back, side, underside and end surfaces visible to an orbiting camera; clean normals/UVs, no unintended holes, seam gaps or z-fighting.
- [ ] Reuse matte graphite/ceramic/dark-panel materials as appropriate. Keep warm architectural light subdued and the timeline dominant; silhouette remains clear without bloom. No baked event text or concept-board captions.
- [ ] Deliver editable modeling source, glTF 2.0 `.glb`, required maps or documented shared-material dependencies, and preview render(s).
- [ ] Document scale, transforms, pivot/axes/attachment points, triangle/material counts and source provenance/license. Add lower-detail variants only when justified; performance budgets remain provisional until measured.
- [ ] Verify import, scale, material slots and assembly fit in the pinned Godot build; record version and results. Issue creation itself does not constitute runtime validation.

## Scope boundary
Model production and import/fit review only. Runtime orbit/panel tracking, screen-space readers, live text/icons, event media, lighting/shader behavior and content-contract extensions are separate. Focus corners and node emphasis use replaceable overlays/materials unless graybox review establishes a physical mesh need. No separate reader, character, ship, statue, city, camera track or per-event diorama is required.
